| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Object | Object, Boundaries over the image | The object as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel, or its boundary in yellow over the image. |
| **Seeds** `seeds` | Selection and image edge | Selection and image edge, Selection as a map | With the selection and image edge, the selected pixels are object seeds and the unselected pixels on the image edge are background seeds. As a map, pixels selected at 192 or more are object seeds, those at 63 or less are background seeds, and partly selected pixels are unknown. |
| **Edge contrast** `sigma` | 10 | 1 to 100 levels | The sigma in the boundary weight. Neighbors that differ by much more than sigma are cheap to cut apart. Boykov and Jolly set it from the camera noise. 10 is our choice. |
| **Region weight** `lambda` | 1 | 0 to 10 | The weight lambda of the region terms against the boundary terms. |
